question.ms: Di manakah lokasi kedai Al Hafiz Nur Al-Madinah?
question.en: Where is Al Hafiz Nur Al-Madinah located?

answer.ms: Kami terletak di Eco Grandeur, Puncak Alam, Selangor. Sila lihat halaman Kunjungi Kami untuk arah dan pautan Google Maps.
answer.en: We are located in Eco Grandeur, Puncak Alam, Selangor. See our Visit Us page for directions and a Google Maps link.

answer.ms: Kedai kami dibuka setiap hari. Waktu operasi terkini dipaparkan di bahagian bawah setiap halaman dan di halaman Kunjungi Kami.
answer.en: We are open every day. Our current opening hours are shown in the footer of every page and on the Visit Us page.

question.ms: Adakah produk anda asli dan diimport?
question.en: Are your products authentic and imported?

answer.ms: Ya. Wangian Arab, kurma dan barangan Timur Tengah kami diimport terus daripada sumber yang dipercayai dan dipilih dengan teliti untuk kualiti.
answer.en: Yes. Our Arabic perfumes, dates and Middle Eastern goods are imported directly from trusted sources and hand-selected for quality.

question.en: Can I place an order via WhatsApp?

answer.ms: Boleh. Hubungi kami melalui WhatsApp atau telefon untuk pertanyaan produk dan tempahan. Butiran terdapat di halaman Hubungi.
answer.en: Yes. Reach us on WhatsApp or by phone for product enquiries and orders. Details are on the Contact page.
